caption: The nine window values and the same nine sorted: the 255 impulse falls to the last rank and the 5th value stays 11, so the median returns 11 while the mean (37.8) and midpoint (132) are dragged up by the impulse.

spec.title: One impulse in a 3×3 window
spec.aria: A 3×3 window holding one very bright 255 pixel, the same nine values in sorted order with the middle value 11 picked out, and the three results: mean 37.8, median 11, midpoint 132.
